headline: Sidewalk petitions for Clover and Heard Streets denied after residents opposed them.
summary: Public speakers said few people walk Clover Street and objected to the cost. Public Works estimated $49,700 to $70,000 for each Clover Street section and $55,500 for Heard Street from Clover to Cowden. Ballots sent to abutters came back 11 opposed and one in favor, and they were non-binding. The committee also approved honorary street names for Hancock Street and Piedmont Street.
decisions: Denied the sidewalk petitions for Clover and Heard Streets, 3-0.
Approved the honorary street name Aris and Ward for Laurel Street, 3-0.
Approved the honorary street name Juana and Daniel Way for Hancock Street from Main Street to Hollis Street, as amended, 3-0.
Approved the honorary street name Mines Moe Morradian Way for Piedmont Street, 3-0.
Approved removing the streetlight on Ware Street, 3-0.
Withdrew the sidewalk resurfacing request for 75 Providence Street, with National Grid to make the permanent repair, 3-0.
Added the Norfolk Street sidewalk repair from Suffolk Street to Groton Place to the sidewalk repair list, subject to funding, 3-0.
Added sidewalk repair in front of Worcester State University, 486 Chandler Street, to the sidewalk repair list, pending funding, 3-0.
Added the Mill Street sidewalk repair from 503 to 505 Mill Street to Logan Field to the pending list, 3-0.
Approved a guardrail at Bleecker and Plantation Streets, pending design and funding, 3-0.
Withdrew the request to replace the dead-end wall on Ingles Street with a guardrail, 3-0.
Held the item on granite survey markers on the agenda, 3-0.
Held the request to extend fencing at Harrington Field, 720 Franklin Street, 3-0.
Approved adding Rip Riley Street to the pothole repair list and the street resurfacing list, as amended, pending budget and council selection, 3-0.
Added Barry Road from Linwood Lane to Barry Road Extension to the pending list of streets to be resurfaced, 3-0.
discussion: Clover and Heard Street sidewalks: Public speakers said few people walk the street and that the cost would be a burden. Public Works estimated $55 a linear foot, and some corner lots would pay for both roads.
Ware Street streetlight: A resident said the light shines into her home all night. Public Works said the nearest other streetlight is about 250 feet away and made no recommendation.
Worcester State sidewalk repair: Public Works estimated $500,000 or more to rebuild the petitioned sidewalk, more than the $120,000 a district has in sidewalk funding for a year.
Mill Street corridor project: Public Works said the project is in designer selection, with new sidewalks, bike lanes and ADA ramps planned. A public meeting is expected at the end of this year.
Granite survey markers: Public Works will propose money in the FY28 capital budget to have the markers cut down and reset. It will also work with Planning on standards for new subdivisions.
